sentences.text: Knowledge of the animal comes primarily from partial postcranial remains.
Fossils were first uncovered in 1974 by Keith Watts.
The type specimen, catalogued as QMF 7292, was formally designated as the holotype in 2009 by Scott Hocknull and colleagues.
Researchers proposed that the previously named species Austrosaurus mckillopi is a nomen dubium, differing only slightly from the holotype of Wintonotitan wattsii.
In its 2009 description, the animal was classified as a non-titanosaurian titanosauriform sauropod.
The animal lived during the Cenomanian to Turonian stages, approximately 100.5 to 89.8 million years ago.
The holotype fossils were found in sandstone interpreted as a river point bar.
